name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – Before § 1 – Am 36
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: -1. Stresses that peace and security are not achieved by promoting a policy of confrontation and war, an increase in military expenditure, an escalation of arms or the militarisation of the EU and its transformation into a military bloc, but through diplomacy, dialogue and a political resolution of conflicts, on the basis of collective security and respect for the principles of the UN Charter and international law;
